    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.ExactClassGroup.torsionFree_identifies_support {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] (F : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) [F.IsClosedUnderExtensions] [F.IsClosedUnderSubobjects] (h₀ : F 0) (length : ∀ (X : C), ∃ (l : Multiset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton C)), HasCompositionFactors X l) :
    Function.Injective ⇑(inclusion F) ∧ (inclusion F).range = supportSubgroup F

    The inclusion of a torsion-free class in a length abelian category identifies its inherited Grothendieck group with its coordinate subgroup.
